calculate_bbox_iou: calculate intersection over union between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with mode iou
calculate_bbox_iof: calculate intersection over foreground between two sets of bounding boxes using bbox_overlaps with mode iof
calculate_aligned_bbox_overlaps: calculate IoU between aligned pairs of bounding boxes by setting aligned to True in bbox_overlaps
calculate_cpu_bbox_overlaps: compute bounding box overlaps on CPU using the _bbox_overlaps_cpu function with torch tensors
handle_empty_bbox_overlaps: handle edge cases with empty bounding box tensors by passing empty tensors to bbox_overlaps
